parallel.requirements: The parallel run worked from the prompt requiring pure Node.js ESM, .mjs files, exact argv behavior, no external dependencies, black-box executable probing, and final /output/test2.mjs.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent kept implementation ownership while launching a broad workflow for black-box domain probes and a critic over /tmp/spec outputs.
parallel.implementation: It generated many jsonschema and Python-compatibility library modules, reflecting substantial behavior modeling, but did not generate the required entry test2.mjs.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The artifact validation listed library files only and marked expected_entry test2.mjs with ok false, so final delivery was incomplete.
parallel.verification: Parallel used executable probes and child workflow probing, but the workflow ended killed with null result and official evaluation later completed 0 of 157.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The probe/critic workflow did not return an aggregate result, several children remained in progress after retries, and the required executable entry file was missing.

serial.requirements: The serial run had the identical prompt and worked on the same pure Node.js ESM, .mjs, manual argv, zero-dependency, black-box jsonschema port requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It proceeded as a single agent with no workflow calls or subagents, combining probing, coding, and local verification in one trajectory.
serial.implementation: It wrote a substantial set of library modules for parsing, validation, refs, metaschemas, and keyword behavior, but did not finish the entry file.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The final artifact listed libraries under lib but artifact validation still expected test2.mjs and ok was false.
serial.verification: Serial ran local executable probes and checks without child handoffs; official evaluation completed and also reported 0 of 157 with solution_passed false.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The direct single-agent implementation timed out before producing the required test2.mjs entry, so no testcases could pass officially.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the jsonschema CLI migration task and the prompt's ESM, .mjs, zero-dependency, manual argv, and /output/test2.mjs requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had the same prompt and recognized the same ESM, .mjs, zero-dependency, manual argv, and final entry-file requirements.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No requirement prompt difference explains the official outcome; both ultimately missed the required test2.mjs entry despite generating libraries.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split behavioral discovery into an 11-domain workflow and parent-side implementation, with 17 child logs recorded.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used a single-agent local plan with no subagents or workflow calls.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The material process difference is the parallel fan-out/retry structure versus serial's direct local probing and writing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child context was detailed by domain and intended to write specs under /tmp/spec for later critic aggregation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept task context inside one trajectory, so no child brief, cross-agent contract, or returned handoff boundary existed.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The problem was not missing child context or interface contracts; it was that the broad probe handoff never completed as an aggregate result.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel generated many library modules under lib/jsonschema and lib/python but the artifact list lacked the required entry file.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial generated a different set of library modules under lib but likewise lacked the required entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both pursued substantial library implementation but neither delivered the executable test2.mjs required by the evaluator.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel's workflow launched child probes and retried stalled workers, but the workflow state ended killed with result null.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child result lifecycle; its work products were direct local writes in the single trajectory.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Only parallel had a child-result lifecycle failure: the broad probe/critic result never reached a usable parent-level return.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote many final-tree libraries and used /tmp scratch specs, but no concrete overwrite or final-tree contamination was proven.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote libraries directly in /output without concurrent writers and also ended with missing entry file.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The final shared-state difference is not a proven write collision; both final artifacts were incomplete, with parallel additionally leaving incomplete workflow scratch/probe state.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel relied on extensive child probing and local tests, but official evaluation completed at 0 of 157 and solution_passed false.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran local probes/checks in one trajectory, but official evaluation also completed at 0 of 157 and solution_passed false.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The official result is not discordant: both fail completely, and the missing entry file dominates acceptance.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel timed out after using one workflow, 17 subagents, 415 workflow-child tool calls, and 1,778,855 workflow-child tokens.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also timed out, but with zero subagents, zero workflow tasks, and no workflow-child tokens.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both closed unsuccessfully, but only parallel spent a large finite budget on broad child fan-out that failed to aggregate before closure.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: parallel and serial both failed, each with 0 of 157 samples and solution_passed false. The concrete common delivery failure is that artifact validation for both modes expected test2.mjs while listing only library files. Parallel nevertheless differed materially in process: it launched an eleven-domain child probe workflow that stalled, retried, and was killed with a null aggregate result; serial kept all probing and implementation in one trajectory with no delegation.
parallel_contributors: Broad probe fan-out consumed substantial workflow budget and ended killed with no aggregate probe/critic result.
The final artifact lacked the required test2.mjs entry file despite many library modules.
serial_contributors: The single-agent attempt also timed out and lacked the required test2.mjs entry file.
Serial avoided child delegation, so it did not suffer a child-result aggregation failure.
ordinary_implementation_differences: The two attempts wrote different library layouts and partial jsonschema implementations, but both missed the executable entry required by the prompt and evaluator.
Both failures are dominated by incomplete delivery rather than a proven difference in final validator semantics.
evaluator_effects: The official evaluator consistently reports 0/157 for both completed evaluations; artifact validation already shows the missing expected entry in both modes.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is a realized adverse parallel process consequence only
